bullets.text: Wildfires are spreading rapidly across France and Spain, forcing over 250,000 people to evacuate their homes. Spanish authorities have warned of 'complex hours' ahead as firefighters battle to contain the blazes.

Russian forces launched a missile attack on a drone exhibition near Kyiv, killing ten people, including prominent members of the Ukrainian defence industry. This incident occurred amidst ongoing political challenges for Ukrainian President Zelensky following his decision to remove the defence minister.

A health worker who had been working in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where an Ebola outbreak is ongoing, is now being monitored in a London hospital for potential Ebola infection. This highlights the global reach of health concerns.
An Illawarra family's attempt to build a second modular home on their property has been deemed by authorities to constitute a "manufactured housing estate," leading to a two-year struggle.
Small towns in outback Queensland, such as Yaraka, are facing the disappearance of public pools due to local councils' inability to afford replacements.
A proposed mega datacentre in outer Melbourne, nearly six times the size of Chadstone shopping centre, is sparking national debate and a petition for careful assessment.
Investors are increasing their bets on a Federal Reserve rate hike following a sharp surge in oil prices, leading many to believe next week's US central bank meeting will be 'live'.
Big Tech's demand for AI investment is causing a surge in bond sales, significantly impacting the US corporate bond market.
Fewer investors than ever believe central bankers will successfully bring inflation back to target levels, indicating a shift in market expectations regarding monetary policy.
